resources.string: Some videos cannot play directly on the TV. Open Playback on the left of the bottom control bar and try Mirror screen. Then reopen the video on your device.
Play videos on your device and mirror their picture and sound to the TV.
Select this TV in the video’s AirPlay menu. Supported videos play on the TV and can be controlled from your device. An existing screen mirroring stream may not switch automatically.
The receiver stays running. If the picture does not return, reopen the video on your device. Some apps may require reconnecting.
Screen mirroring selected. Exit the AirPlay video screen on your device and reopen the video. If no picture appears, reconnect screen mirroring.
